script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for August 2. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Empires rise and fall.  Companies come and go.  Even stars eventually burn out.

Sustainable systems don't consume more than they replenish. Overfishing depletes oceans. Overwork depletes people. The math is simple: take more than regenerates, and eventually there's nothing left. Nothing lasts without maintenance.  Roads need repair.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: What can't continue, won't.  If you're borrowing from the future, the bill eventually comes due.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Sustainability Audit - Can This Continue?.

Here's your activity: Pick one area—work pace, spending, health habits, relationship investment. Could you sustain this for 20 years? If not, what would sustainable look like? Small adjustments now prevent forced changes later. This helps you evaluate long-term sustainability of current patterns.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about what it takes to last can be applied to sustainability audit - can this continue?. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
